rows.reason: The title of the construct for common attributes is the same atomic retrieval. The new prompt uses VERWEIS as an example of the existing Grade 7 modelling task.
A long Grade 6 review prompt bundles instances, state, methods and UML. The new lesson applies only the object/class distinction and the link attributes. There is no full equivalent.
The old prompt asks about nesting within an HTML document and the DOM tree. The new lesson models linked documents as a directed graph and sets links in a visual editor.
The old prompt bundles hypertext navigation, HTML nesting rules, the DOM and file paths. The new lessons practise navigation and URL components, so the full prior retrieval has no equivalent.

source: Thomas approved the proposed transfers for German 7 Realschule, French 6 Gymnasium and Natur und Technik 7 Gymnasium (Informatics) in the Codex chat for ZAM 0.67.0 on 2026-11-21: “Alle sieben vorgeschlagenen Übernahmen freigeben und die drei Kurse einbinden”.
